decisions.reason: Its documented customer savings of more than €600,000 per year put performance clearly above aspiration levels, and in a growing, innovative firm this strongly supports continued commitment.

Although hard outcome data are limited, it remained actively presented across two years, fits closely with the core range, and the firm's growth and slack justify keeping it while learning more about market response.
The reported customer adoption and quantified savings after more than a year indicate performance at or above aspiration, so management would retain it and build on this validated concept.

As a 2024 launch close to the established business, it is too early to judge harshly, and the firm's organisational slack and strategic direction favor continued market testing rather than withdrawal.

This new 2024 product extends the firm's processing-systems logic and, absent evidence of underperformance, a growing R&D-oriented machinery firm would keep it on the market to accumulate feedback and sales experience.
